FarmerRecord.title: FarmerRecord
FarmerRecord.description: Authoritative source record held by the Farmer Registry, and the ONLY source of a FarmerIdentityCredential's claims. services/farmer-issuer resolves the AUTHENTICATED national id to exactly one record here; neither a wallet nor a caller may supply or select farmerId. Synthetic data only: see scripts/seed-agriculture.sh. This entity belongs to the Agriculture use case alone — DESIGN forbids a shared cross-domain person table, so it must not read or extend AgeCitizen, and the Land Registry must not read it.

farmerId.title: Farmer ID
farmerId.description: The Agriculture correlation identifier, e.g. FRM-KA-0041. This is the value a bank correlates across the two credentials. Deliberately a different namespace and sequence from nationalId and landId: PRODUCT forbids treating any of the three as interchangeable.

nationalId.title: National ID
nationalId.description: Issuer-side lookup only, e.g. NAT-90018472. Matched against the authenticated Keycloak account's nationalId claim to decide whose credential may be issued. NEVER issued as a credential claim and never disclosed to the bank.

registeredFarmer.title: Registered farmer
registeredFarmer.description: Whether the registry recognises this person as a registered farmer. A required input to the loan rule, and the reason a valid credential can still produce NOT ELIGIBLE.

farmerCategory.title: Farmer category
farmerCategory.description: Landholding category. Issued as a disclosable claim but never requested by the bank, which is what makes selective disclosure demonstrable rather than assumed.

district.title: District
district.description: Issued as a disclosable claim. Not requested by the bank.
